ConditionalVisibilitySettings.Expression:
$currentObject != empty and $currentObject/Height != empty
and 
($currentObject/WorkOrderId != empty or $currentObject/WorkOrderId != '')

DataSource.XPathConstraint:
[(CurrentWorkOrderId = $currentObject/WorkOrderId)
and (($currentObject/ParentFolderId = empty and (ParentEntityId = empty)) or
   ($currentObject/ParentFolderId != empty and (ParentEntityId= $currentObject/ParentFolderId)
))]

[CurrentWorkOrderId = $currentObject/WorkOrderId
and (($currentObject/ParentFolderId = empty and (FromNodeParentEntityId = empty or ToNodeParentEntityId = empty)) or
   ($currentObject/ParentFolderId != empty and (FromNodeParentEntityId = $currentObject/ParentFolderId or ToNodeParentEntityId = $currentObject/ParentFolderId)
))]

Value.Expression:
if $currentObject/IsExternalDependency
then 'external-dependency'
else if $currentObject/IsPreferred
then 'preferred-dependency'
else ''

PropertyTypes.Caption: Parent node ID *
PropertyTypes.Description: If a graph of nested nodes needs to be rendered a parent node id should be supplied. This can then be used in the edges and nodes datasources to retrieve the correct data. The widget will also change this attribute on double-clicking a node

PropertyTypes.Caption: Zoom to node
PropertyTypes.Description: When a change to this attribute is detected the widget will zoom to the node ID supplied in the attribute. After this the attribute will be cleared.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Zoom nodes
PropertyTypes.Description: Default: 2. Defines how many nodes around the target node (the node to zoom in on) should be visible on both the left and right side.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Graph min height
PropertyTypes.Description: Default: 500px, minimal height of the graph.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Has children *
PropertyTypes.Description: If the node has nested/sub nodes

PropertyTypes.Caption: On click action
PropertyTypes.Description: Define a single click action. Double-click will show the sub graph if possible and ctrl + click will zoom on the node

PropertyTypes.Caption: On double-click
PropertyTypes.Description: This action will be triggered along with opening the sub graph (if the node has children). The double click action will always be performed so it can be used to provide feedback when no children are available.

PropertyTypes.Caption: CSS Class
PropertyTypes.Description: The class will be applied to both the polyline and the label elements.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Highlighted Source Node ID
PropertyTypes.Description: ID of the source node to highlight in the graph.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Highlighted Destination Node ID
PropertyTypes.Description: ID of the destination node to highlight in the graph.

Type.WidgetDescription: Renders a graph with nodes and edges visualizing the dependencies and relation of the nodes
